```yaml
name: Go CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [develop, main]
    tags: ['*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [develop, main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: ['1.26']
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run go vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: v1.61
          args: --timeout=5m

      - name: Run Go tests with race
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')) }}
        run: go test ./... -race -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic

      - name: Run Go tests without race
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' || (github.ref != 'refs/heads/develop' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')) }}
        run: go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic

      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: coverage.out

      - name: Run gofix drift check
        run: |
          go install golang.org/x/tools/cmd/gofix@latest
          gofix -check ./...

      - name: Run precommit
        run: make precommit
```
